english: In-context segmentation transfers a target from an annotated reference image to a query image.
chinese: 定义 ICS：把 annotated reference 中指定的目标迁移到 query。

english: We compare two training-free systems, INSID3 and CG-ICS, to examine how visual correspondence and concept-guided search affect accuracy, reference sensitivity, and inference cost.
chinese: 交代比较对象 INSID3 / CG-ICS，以及 accuracy、reference sensitivity、inference cost 三条评价轴。

english: On COCO-$20^i$ and LVIS-$92^i$, CG-ICS achieves mean-fold class-pooled IoU of 72.17\% and 47.44\%, versus 57.65\% and 40.77\% for INSID3.
chinese: 给出主结果：CG-ICS 的 COCO/LVIS mean-fold class-pooled IoU 为 72.17/47.44，INSID3 为 57.65/40.77。

english: This improvement comes with 7.37--10.63 times greater mean inference latency on input pairs with the same runner GPU model and an additional language-model GPU.
chinese: 说明 accuracy 的代价：匹配 runner GPU model 后 mean inference latency 为 7.37–10.63 倍，且另占 MLLM GPU。

english: Component experiments identify distinct sources of performance: INSID3 benefits from feature debiasing and region aggregation, whereas CG-ICS benefits strongly from combining a semantic concept with visual prompts.
chinese: 归纳两系统的有效成分：INSID3 的 debiasing / aggregation，CG-ICS 的 semantic concept + visual prompts。

english: Additional concept search yields only a 0.22-point equal-query IoU gain on COCO but a 2.30-point gain on LVIS.
chinese: 指出额外 concept search 的平均收益不一致：COCO 0.22 pp，LVIS 2.30 pp。

english: In the paired-input cohort, visual prompting reduces the marginal gain from search.
chinese: 概括 search–prompt interaction：加入 visual prompting 后 search 的边际收益降低。

english: Reference variation and small-target failures further distinguish the systems.
chinese: 补充 reference variation 与 small-target failure，避免只看均值。

english: These findings motivate Agreement-Gated Search (AGS), for which we derive a cost--accuracy decomposition and specify a controlled evaluation.
chinese: 从证据导向 AGS proposal，并引出 cost–accuracy decomposition 与 controlled evaluation。

english: The report combines completed comparative evidence with this extension, whose experimental results are pending.
chinese: 界定当前贡献状态：比较实验完成，extension 的 empirical results 尚待验收。

english: Code is available at \url{https://github.com/AvianHan/CE6190-Visual-Understanding}.
chinese: 提供可点击GitHub repo link，与Group report的abstract末尾做法一致。

english: In-context segmentation (ICS) identifies a target in a query image from a reference image and its binary mask.
chinese: 给出 ICS 的三项输入和目标。

english: This interface allows a user to specify the target visually, without annotating each query or fitting a new task-specific model.
chinese: 解释这种接口的价值：用户给 visual example，无需逐张 query 标注或重新训练 task-specific model。

english: Reliable transfer remains difficult: the same category can change appearance, the reference may emphasize only part of an object, and the query can contain visually or semantically similar distractors.
chinese: 列出 transfer 的困难：appearance change、partial reference、distractors。

english: A practical system must resolve these ambiguities at an acceptable inference cost.
chinese: 把困难收束为一个工程目标：在可接受 inference cost 下消歧。

english: Recent foundation models support two distinct solutions.
chinese: 引入 foundation model 提供的两条解决路线。

english: INSID3 constructs a mask from frozen DINOv3 features through debiasing, clustering, and similarity aggregation~\cite{insid3,dinov3}.
chinese: INSID3 通过 frozen DINOv3 的 debiasing、clustering、similarity aggregation 构造 mask。

english: CG-ICS generates language concepts from the reference, evaluates and searches these concepts, and combines them with visual prompts in SAM~3~\cite{cgics,sam3}.
chinese: CG-ICS 通过 reference-derived concepts、search 和 SAM 3 visual prompts 构造 mask。

english: Their central difference is how the reference becomes actionable evidence: direct visual correspondence in one system, and concept-guided segmentation supported by visual transfer in the other.
chinese: 总结比较轴：reference 如何转化为可用于 query 的 evidence。

english: A headline accuracy comparison leaves important behavior unresolved.
chinese: 指出 headline accuracy comparison 本身不足。

english: An improvement may depend on the reference, arise from a particular processing stage, or require expensive search that benefits only some inputs.
chinese: 列出待解释因素：reference、processing stage、不同 input 的 search 收益。

english: Complete-system evaluation therefore needs to be connected to component interventions and measured cost.
chinese: 因此需要把 whole-system evaluation 与 component intervention、measured cost 连接起来。

english: This connection is also necessary for designing an efficient extension: search should be reduced where its marginal value is small, while preserving it where the initial prediction is inadequate.
chinese: 进一步导出效率目标：减少低 marginal value 的 search，保留初始预测不足时的 search。

english: We study these questions on COCO-$20^i$ and LVIS-$92^i$ using common reference/query inputs and original-resolution evaluation.
chinese: 限定本研究的数据与协议：COCO/LVIS，common inputs，original-resolution evaluation。

english: CG-ICS is more accurate overall, while INSID3 is substantially faster.
chinese: 先给总体发现：CG-ICS 更准，INSID3 更快。

english: The component results sharpen this comparison: a single concept combined with visual prompts captures most of CG-ICS's gain on COCO, whereas LVIS benefits more from further search.
chinese: 再给机制发现：COCO 的 single concept + visual prompts 已获得多数收益，LVIS 更受益于 extra search。

english: Moreover, visual prompting reduces the marginal search gain on both datasets.
chinese: 指出 visual prompting 在两个数据集都降低 search 的 observed marginal gain。

english: This measured interaction motivates an input-dependent search rule based on agreement between text-only and visual-only predictions.
chinese: 从此提出可观察 signal：text-only / visual-only predictions 的 agreement，用于 input-dependent search。
role_evidence: 有动机的假说；不是已验证 gate 性能

english: Our contributions are threefold:
chinese: 将Our contributions are threefold接在前段末尾，随后列出三项贡献。

english: \textbf{Paired system evaluation.} We compare accuracy, reference sensitivity, and computational cost on common inputs.
chinese: Contribution 1：common inputs 上比较 accuracy、reference sensitivity、computational cost。

english: \textbf{Component analysis.} We separate feature processing, semantic search, visual prompting, and backbone choice through controlled interventions.
chinese: Contribution 2：通过 controlled interventions 区分 feature processing、semantic search、visual prompting、backbone choice。

english: \textbf{Agreement-Gated Search.} We propose input-dependent search with an explicit cost--accuracy formulation and predefined controls.
chinese: Contribution 3：提出 AGS，给出 explicit cost–accuracy formulation 和 predefined controls。

english: The empirical conclusions use the completed first batch; the extension is being evaluated separately on fresh queries and transfer datasets.
chinese: 声明empirical conclusions来自completed first batch，extension正在fresh queries与transfer datasets上独立评价。
role_evidence: 已改为being evaluated，避免暗示完成

english: Visual understanding requires both semantic recognition and spatial localization.
chinese: 从 visual understanding 的两项需求开场：semantic recognition 和 spatial localization。

english: Vision Transformers represent images as patch tokens~\cite{vit}, while self-supervised learning in DINO produces features that capture object structure without task-specific labels~\cite{dino}.
chinese: ViT 的 patch tokens 与 DINO 的 self-supervised object structure 提供 feature 路线背景。

english: DINOv2 and DINOv3 extend this representation approach at scale~\cite{dinov2,dinov3}.
chinese: DINOv2 / DINOv3 将这一 representation 路线扩展到更大规模。

english: Their dense features support correspondence across images, providing a basis for transferring an annotated target from a reference to a query.
chinese: 说明这些 dense features 如何服务跨图 correspondence，从而服务 reference→query transfer。

english: Promptable foundation models expose spatial and semantic information through a segmentation interface.
chinese: 转向 promptable foundation models，把 semantic/spatial information 变成 segmentation interface。

english: SAM predicts masks from spatial prompts~\cite{sam}; SAM~2 extends this interface to video~\cite{sam2}; and SAM~3 supports concept-level prompts~\cite{sam3}.
chinese: 按 SAM→SAM 2→SAM 3 串起 spatial prompts、video、concept prompts。

english: CLIP connects visual representations with language through image--text alignment~\cite{clip}, while models such as Qwen3-VL support multimodal reasoning~\cite{qwen3vl}.
chinese: CLIP 的 image–text alignment 与 Qwen3-VL 的 multimodal reasoning 补足 language 一侧。

english: Together, these capabilities enable the two routes studied here: identifying a target through dense visual correspondence, or describing it semantically and grounding that description with a promptable segmenter.
chinese: 把文献能力重新收束为本文的 visual correspondence vs semantic grounding 两条路线。

english: Reference-conditioned segmentation builds on one-shot prediction~\cite{oslsm}, support prototypes~\cite{panet}, and dense support--query correspondence~\cite{hsnet}.
chinese: 从 one-shot、prototypes、dense correspondence 追溯 reference-conditioned segmentation。

english: Visual in-context learning broadens this idea by expressing tasks through image examples: visual prompting casts prediction as image completion~\cite{visualprompt}, Painter learns across dense prediction tasks~\cite{painter}, and SegGPT provides a general context-conditioned segmentation interface~\cite{seggpt}.
chinese: 用 visual prompting、Painter、SegGPT 说明 example 本身可以表达 task。

english: These approaches establish the annotated example as a flexible specification of the desired output.
chinese: 归纳 annotated example 是 desired output 的 flexible specification。

english: Recent methods differ in how they turn that example into a query mask.
chinese: 指出近期方法的区别在于 example 如何变成 query mask。

english: SegIC turns foundation-model correspondences into geometric, visual, and meta instructions~\cite{segic}; SINE introduces in-context interaction~\cite{sine}; and VRP-SAM learns a reference-prompt encoder~\cite{vrpsam}.
chinese: SegIC把foundation-model correspondences转化为geometric、visual、meta instructions；SINE与VRP-SAM分别展示interaction与reference prompt encoding。

english: Frozen-model pipelines instead reuse pretrained representations and segmentation priors: PerSAM derives target-specific information from one example~\cite{persam}, and Matcher links general feature matching to promptable segmentation~\cite{matcher}.
chinese: PerSAM 和 Matcher 展示 frozen representations 与 segmentation priors 的组合。

english: INSID3 operates directly on DINOv3 features~\cite{insid3}, whereas CG-ICS combines generated concepts, search, and visual exemplars~\cite{cgics}.
chinese: 将 INSID3 的直接 feature processing 与 CG-ICS 的 concepts/search/visual exemplars 对照。

english: We compare these last two complete inference systems and then examine their individual processing stages.
chinese: 明确本文选取这两个 full inference systems，并继续拆解其 stages。

english: The chosen reference is itself a source of variation.
chinese: 提醒 reference 本身会引入 variability。

english: Good Examples studies example selection~\cite{goodexamples}, UNICL-SAM addresses uncertainty in imperfect examples~\cite{unicl}, and CG-ICS explicitly targets reference robustness~\cite{cgics}.
chinese: Good Examples、UNICL-SAM、CG-ICS 各自讨论 example selection、uncertainty、reference robustness。

english: Our reference study measures performance when the query is fixed and the supplied demonstration changes.
chinese: 本文固定 query、改变 demonstration，量化 reference sensitivity。

english: Cross-domain work provides a complementary perspective: RePRI uses transductive optimization~\cite{repri}, while ABCDFSS adapts feature-processing layers at test time~\cite{abcdfss}.
chinese: RePRI 的 transductive optimization 与 ABCDFSS 的 test-time adaptation 提供 cross-domain 参照。

english: Their adaptation mechanisms differ from the frozen inference evaluated here, motivating a separate domain-transfer analysis.
chinese: 将这些 adaptation mechanisms 与当前 frozen inference 区分，解释为何 domain transfer 需要单独评价。

english: Given a reference image $I_r$, its foreground mask $M_r$, and a query image $I_q$, an ICS system predicts
chinese: 给出形式化接口：输入 reference image、reference mask、query image，输出 query mask。

english: The task is binary segmentation of the demonstrated semantic target.
chinese: 限定输出为所示 semantic target 的 binary segmentation。

english: Query ground truth is used only for evaluation; the dataset class label is not supplied to inference.
chinese: query GT 仅用于 evaluation；inference 不接收 dataset class label。
role_evidence: 防止 label leakage 的核心约束

english: Both systems use pretrained models without task-specific parameter updates.
chinese: 两系统均使用 pretrained models，不做 task-specific parameter updates。

english: We first compare their complete pipelines, then vary components within each pipeline and cross feature trunks with a common processing interface.
chinese: 说明比较顺序：full pipelines→within-system components→common interface 下的 trunks。

english: INSID3 uses the semantic correspondence and spatial grouping structure of frozen DINOv3 features~\cite{insid3,dinov3}.
chinese: INSID3 的信息来源是 frozen DINOv3 的 semantic correspondence 与 spatial grouping。

english: Figure~\ref{fig:insid3} separates two feature paths.
chinese: Figure 1 将 original / debiased 两条 feature paths 分开。

english: Original query features provide coherent clusters and within-query similarity.
chinese: original query features 用于 coherent clustering 和 within-query similarity。

english: Debiased reference and query features provide cross-image matching, reducing the influence of absolute image position.
chinese: debiased reference/query features 用于 cross-image matching，弱化 absolute position。

english: Let $F$ be a matrix of dense features and $B$ an orthonormal basis for the estimated positional subspace.
chinese: 定义 dense-feature matrix F 与 positional-subspace orthonormal basis B。

english: Debiasing projects onto its orthogonal complement and normalizes each feature,
chinese: 通过投影到 positional subspace 的 orthogonal complement 再 normalize 实现 debiasing。

english: A foreground prototype averages debiased reference features inside $M_r$.
chinese: 在 reference foreground 内平均 debiased features，构造 foreground prototype。

english: Forward similarity and backward correspondence identify query candidates, and the prototype selects a seed cluster.
chinese: forward similarity / backward correspondence 找 candidates，prototype 选择 seed cluster。

english: In the evaluated implementation, final aggregation combines each cluster's cross-image alignment, original-space similarity to the seed, and candidate coverage.
chinese: 在本次evaluated implementation中，aggregation组合cross-image alignment、original-space seed similarity、candidate coverage。
role_evidence: 实际实现步骤；不混同论文全部细节

english: Clusters above the merge threshold form the prediction.
chinese: 超过 merge threshold 的 clusters 组成最终 mask。

english: Our component study crosses debiasing on/off with self-plus-cross, cross-only, and seed-only aggregation; seed-only output retains clustering.
chinese: INSID3 ablation：debiasing on/off × 三种 aggregation；seed-only 仍含 clustering。

english: The simple-similarity control retains debiasing but omits clustered region processing.
chinese: simple-similarity control 保留 debiasing，但不做 clustered region processing。

english: The main configuration uses input size 1024, positional rank 500, clustering threshold 0.6, merge threshold 0.2, and bilinear output restoration.
chinese: 列出主设置：1024 input、rank 500、clustering 0.6、merge 0.2、bilinear restoration。

english: Implementation-specific details are recorded in Appendix~\ref{app:protocol}.
chinese: implementation-specific details 放入 Appendix。

english: CG-ICS combines concept search with a parallel visual transfer route~\cite{cgics}.
chinese: CG-ICS 包含 concept search 与 parallel visual transfer。

english: A multimodal language model generates candidate concepts from the reference and a highlighted view of the annotated target.
chinese: MLLM 从 reference 与 highlighted target 生成 candidate concepts。

english: Each concept $c$ is scored by reference fidelity and query presence:
chinese: 按 reference fidelity 和 query presence 给 candidate concept 打分。

english: The query term $s_q$ is SAM~3's presence score.
chinese: query score s_q 为 SAM 3 presence score。

english: Candidate expansion, pruning, restarts, and reranking seek a concept that fits the annotated reference and occurs in the query.
chinese: expansion、pruning、restarts、reranking 寻找同时匹配 reference 且存在于 query 的 concept。

english: The default uses $\alpha=\beta=1$.
chinese: 默认 score exponents α=β=1。

english: The visual branch concatenates the reference and query.
chinese: visual branch 将 reference 和 query 拼接。

english: Reference-mask components provide spatial prompts on this combined image; the resulting query-side masks yield box prompts.
chinese: reference-mask components 产生 spatial prompts，query-side outputs 转为 box prompts。

english: SAM~3 then combines these boxes with the selected concept to segment the query (Figure~\ref{fig:cgics}).
chinese: SAM 3 结合这些 boxes 与 selected concept 输出 query segmentation。

english: We compare a single concept, scored candidates, and full search, each with and without visual boxes.
chinese: 比较 single concept、scored candidates、full search，各配 with/without visual boxes。

english: Visual-only and direct-concatenation outputs provide additional controls.
chinese: visual-only 与 direct concatenation 是额外 controls。

english: The implemented system uses Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct for concept generation~\cite{qwen3vl}, working image size 512, five initial candidates, and three search loops.
chinese: 实现使用 Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct、working size 512、5 initial candidates、3 search loops。

english: SAM~3 applies its own size-1008 preprocessing.
chinese: SAM 3 内部另做 size-1008 preprocessing。

english: The language model and segmenter occupy separate GPUs; this additional language-model allocation is included when interpreting system cost.
chinese: MLLM 与 segmenter 分占 GPUs；system cost 需要计入额外 MLLM allocation。

english: We evaluate COCO-$20^i$ and LVIS-$92^i$, derived from COCO~\cite{coco} and LVIS~\cite{lvis}.
chinese: 说明COCO-20i与LVIS-92i分别派生于COCO与LVIS，并分别引用dataset来源。

english: We use the author-prepared class memberships, with four folds of 20 classes and ten folds of 92 classes, respectively~\cite{matcher}.
chinese: 说明使用author-prepared class memberships：COCO4folds×20classes，LVIS10folds×92classes；foldprotocol单独引用Matcher。

english: The standard comparison contains 4,000 COCO and 23,000 LVIS episodes per system.
chinese: standard comparison 每系统 4,000 COCO、23,000 LVIS episodes。

english: A reference cohort varies the demonstration for fixed query targets.
chinese: reference cohort 固定 query target，改变 demonstration。

english: A separate component cohort contains 400 COCO and 1,000 LVIS query targets, with up to three references each (1,200 and 2,757 episodes per configuration).
chinese: component cohort 为 400 COCO、1,000 LVIS query targets，各最多3 references，对应1,200/2,757 episodes。

english: All methods within a comparison receive matched inputs.
chinese: 同一 comparison 内各方法使用 matched inputs。

english: For each episode, foreground IoU is evaluated at the original query resolution:
chinese: 每 episode 在 original query resolution 计算 foreground IoU。

english: The headline metric pools counts within each class, averages classes within each fold, and then averages folds:
chinese: headline metric：class 内 pool TP/FP/FN，fold 内平均 classes，再平均 folds。

english: For paired comparisons, we first average planned episodes within each query target $u$ (query image, target mask, and concept), then average the method difference:
chinese: paired metric：先对同一 query target 的 planned episodes 平均，再对 method difference 等权平均。

english: Confidence intervals resample whole query-image clusters, keeping their concepts and references together~\cite{bootstrap,clusterbootstrap}.
chinese: bootstrap 按完整 query-image clusters 重采样，concepts 和 references 一起保留。

english: We report exploratory 95\% intervals using 2,000 bootstrap replicates for main/component contrasts and 1,000 for parameter/area analyses.
chinese: 主/component contrasts 用2,000次，parameter/area用1,000次，给 exploratory 95% CIs。

english: Reference sensitivity is the standard deviation across distinct references after averaging repeated executions of identical inputs.
chinese: reference SD 先合并 identical inputs 的 repeated executions，再在不同 references 间计算。

english: Failed predictions retain missing accuracy; paired contrasts use common successful inputs.
chinese: failed predictions 保留 missing accuracy，paired contrasts 使用 common successful inputs。

english: The completed first batch covers 36 configurations and 615,976 episode records, including four preprocessing failures.
chinese: 第一批有36 configurations、615,976 records，其中4 preprocessing failures。

english: All expected episode identities and shard assignments have been verified.
chinese: 已核对 expected episode identities 和 shard assignments。

english: We report each dataset separately and use the executed common protocol for comparative analysis.
chinese: 各 dataset 分开报告，在实际执行的 common protocol 上比较。

english: Protocol details and the full research matrix are in Appendix~\ref{app:protocol}.
chinese: 完整 matrix 与 protocol 放 Appendix。

english: CG-ICS obtains higher accuracy on both datasets (Table~\ref{tab:main}).
chinese: CG-ICS 在两个 dataset 的 headline accuracy 更高。

english: Its paired equal-query advantage is 14.01 points on COCO and 16.22 on LVIS.
chinese: paired equal-query 优势为 COCO14.01 pp、LVIS16.22 pp。

english: The headline class-pooled and paired metrics answer different questions: pooling weights an episode by its predicted/true union within a class, whereas equal-query averaging gives each query target equal weight.
chinese: 区分指标：class pooling 对 episode 按 union size 加权，equal-query 对 query target 等权。
role_evidence: 避免把两列当同一均值

english: On LVIS, CG-ICS's episode-mean IoU is 55.19\%, compared with 47.44\% under mean-fold class pooling.
chinese: LVIS CG-ICS episode mean55.19%，mean-fold class pooling47.44%。

english: Appendix~\ref{app:math} gives the exact weighting identity behind this distinction.
chinese: Appendix 用 exact weighting identity 解释差异。

english: This accuracy advantage has a substantial computational cost.
chinese: accuracy advantage 带来 substantial cost。

english: On exact inputs matched by recorded runner GPU, CG-ICS takes 7.37--10.63 times the mean inference time of INSID3 (Table~\ref{tab:cost}).
chinese: same-input/same-runner-GPU 比较中，CG latency 为 INSID3 的7.37–10.63倍。

english: These times cover inference and exclude model/server startup, evaluation, and output writing.
chinese: 这些 times 仅含 inference，不含 startup、evaluation、writing。

english: The extra language-model GPU makes the resource difference larger than the runner-latency ratio alone suggests.
chinese: CG 额外 MLLM GPU 意味着资源差异不止 latency ratio。

english: The operation counts explain much of this cost: CG-ICS averages 3.43--3.50 language-model requests and 29.89--32.76 SAM calls per standard episode across the recorded hardware strata.
chinese: CG 每 standard episode 约3.43–3.50 MLLM requests、29.89–32.76 SAM calls，解释主要开销。

english: Language-model startup adds a median 58--71 seconds, which matters for small batches.
chinese: MLLM startup median58–71s，小 batch 时明显。

english: Startup and owned-process memory are reported separately in Appendix~\ref{app:cost}.
chinese: startup 与 owned-process memory 另放 Appendix。

english: The complete-system accuracy ranking does not determine the variability ranking.
chinese: accuracy ranking 不自动决定 variability ranking。

english: CG-ICS reduces reference SD on COCO but increases it on LVIS (Table~\ref{tab:reference}).
chinese: CG 在 COCO 降低 reference SD，在 LVIS 增加。

english: Nevertheless, its mean worst-reference IoU is higher on both datasets.
chinese: 但 CG 在两个数据集的 mean worst-reference IoU 均更高。

english: A system can therefore improve the lower end of observed performance while remaining more sensitive to which reference is chosen.
chinese: 因此更高 worst-case-level accuracy 可以与更大 reference sensitivity 同时出现。

english: The same direction appears in H200-only subsets: the CG-ICS minus INSID3 reference-SD interval is $[-3.71,-2.69]$ points on COCO and $[5.03,5.98]$ on LVIS.
chinese: H200-only subsets 中 reference SD difference 的区间仍一负一正。

english: Reference robustness is therefore dataset-dependent, and reduced variability should be interpreted alongside the achieved accuracy.
chinese: reference robustness 是 dataset-dependent，variability 必须结合 accuracy 一起看。

english: A three-seed study fixes the component inputs and yields mean per-input CG-ICS SDs of 2.23 points on COCO and 3.65 on LVIS.
chinese: three-seed 固定 component inputs，CG mean per-input SD为2.23/3.65 pp。

english: Prediction hashes are identical across all three seeds for 263/1,200 and 694/2,757 inputs.
chinese: 263/1,200与694/2,757 inputs 的 prediction hashes 跨3 seeds完全一致。

english: Because some runs use different GPU models, we interpret these as run-sensitivity measurements rather than an isolated seed effect.
chinese: 部分运行混合 GPU model，因此这是 run sensitivity，不是 isolated seed effect。

english: INSID3's gains are not explained by the feature trunk alone.
chinese: INSID3 的收益不只来自 feature trunk。

english: Removing debiasing from the full processing route reduces equal-query IoU by 2.38 points on COCO and 2.26 on LVIS.
chinese: 移除 debiasing 使 COCO/LVIS equal-query IoU下降2.38/2.26 pp。

english: Replacing self-plus-cross aggregation with seed-only output reduces it by 9.24 and 4.06 points, respectively.
chinese: self-plus-cross 改为seed-only下降9.24/4.06 pp。

english: The full processing route improves over debiased simple similarity by 19.23 and 11.94 points.
chinese: full processing 相比debiased similarity提高19.23/11.94 pp。

english: These contrasts indicate that both the representation adjustment and the use of clustered spatial structure matter.
chinese: representation adjustment 与 clustered spatial structure 均有贡献。

english: For CG-ICS, language and visual prompts provide complementary information.
chinese: CG 的 language 与 visual prompts 提供互补信息。

english: Adding visual boxes to a single concept yields 5.39 points on COCO and 4.78 on LVIS; adding a concept to the visual-only system yields 13.38 and 16.54 points.
chinese: single concept 加boxes提高5.39/4.78 pp；visual-only加concept提高13.38/16.54 pp。

english: By contrast, the incremental return from more search depends on the dataset and on the already available visual route.
chinese: extra search 的收益随 dataset 和已有visual route而变。

english: With visual boxes, full search adds 0.22 points beyond a single concept on COCO, with a confidence interval spanning zero; the corresponding LVIS gain is 2.30 points.
chinese: 带boxes时full search比single concept在COCO只提高0.22 pp且CI跨0，LVIS提高2.30 pp。

english: Without boxes, the gains rise to 3.07 and 5.30 points.
chinese: 不带boxes时search收益为3.07/5.30 pp。

english: Thus, the observed contribution of search depends on both the dataset and the visual route.
chinese: search贡献依赖dataset与visual route。

english: The single-concept route is also much cheaper.
chinese: single-concept route成本显著更低。

english: Full search takes 4.17 times as long on 300 matched COCO/H200 inputs and 4.37--4.56 times as long on matched LVIS subsets.
